messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Customer AzureLeaf (eu-north dedicated pool) experiencing p99 latency spike. SLO p99 > 2s (observed 4.2s). Impacting ~35% of requests. Severity: HIGH. Pager: oncall-anna
oncall-anna: Taking incident commander. Oncall handoff inbound.
oncall-anna: @sre-maya can you join? @eng-runtime-raj please pull pool telemetry.
sre-maya: Joining. Looking at Metrics -> https://grafana.internal/redwood/azleaf-eun. p95 ~1.1s, p99 ~4.2s, error rate small (~0.2%). Spikes started ~15:21 UTC.
eng-runtime-raj: Pulling runtime logs & queue stats. Seeing GPU queue depth spike and KV cache miss rate jump from 8% -> 46% for AzureLeaf-specific tenant routing. Correlation with a deploy at 15:20 UTC (canary model-quant-x).
support-oliver: AzureLeaf on support call reporting timeouts and slow responses, correlation with our alerts. Customer log snippet: "req_id=9f3a timeout 3000ms".
oncall-anna: Quick mitigation plan: 1) disable recent canary (model-quant-x) for AzureLeaf route 2) scale dedicated pool +1 node (burst) 3) enable regional fallback to eu-west for critical traffic. Who can flip canary?
eng-runtime-raj: I can revert the canary. Running: 
```
# internal CLI
redwood rollout cancel --customer AzureLeaf --model model-quant-x --region eu-north
```
eng-runtime-raj: rollback triggered.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id: rb-5188889999).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback completed (rb-5188889999) — model-quant-x removed from AzureLeaf route.
sre-maya: Confirming metrics after rollback: p99 -> 2.6s within 4 minutes, queue depth decreasing. KV miss still high but trending down.
oncall-anna: Initiating pool scale: 
```
redwood pools scale --name azureleaf-eun-dedicated --replicas +1 --reason "P99 mitigation"
```
eng-infra-hao: Increased pool by 1 node, new node provisioning OK. Autoscaler also adjusted config for burst policy.
sre-maya: After scale, p99 now ~1.9s and CPU/GPU queues near normal. Remaining tail due to cold KV entries for tenant prefixes. Recommend cache warm for hot prefixes and keep fallback to eu-west for critical seat.
eng-runtime-raj: Starting cache warm job for tenant prefixes: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/tenants/azureleaf/warm-cache -d '{"prefixes": ["/chat/","/embed/"]}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
eng-runtime-raj: Cache warm kicked off, sampling shows hit-rate rising.
support-oliver: Customer on call sees improvement, reporting reduced latencies. They're asking for a short summary and ETA to full resolution.
acct-manager-zoe: I'll draft a customer note: "We reverted a recent canary for your region, added capacity, and warmed caches; monitoring is ongoing. We'll follow up with RCA and timeline within 48-72h."
oncall-anna: Assigning post-mitigation ownership: @sre-maya take lead for monitoring and RCA coordination. I'll schedule handoff to day-shift SRE in 30m.
sre-maya: Acknowledged. Creating internal incident ticket and linking runbook. Ticket: https://inc.internal/incident/5188889999. Runbook: /runbooks/dedicated-pool-tail-latency.md
incident-bot: NOTE: postmortem required (P1 incident). Target: initial RCA draft within 72h.
eng-runtime-raj: Quick root-cause note: a kernel change in the quantized execution path (kernel v2.1-beta) triggers unexpected KV invalidations under certain sequence-length distributions. Reverting that kernel for the AzureLeaf build; will open PR to remove canary from region-specific builds.
support-oliver: Logging customer action items: update on-call notes, share timeline, schedule follow-up call with AzureLeaf in 2h.
oncall-anna: Good work team. Keep updates short in this thread. Closing war room in 1h unless regression. :thumbsup:
sre-maya: I'll monitor and post closure when metrics stable for 30m.
eng-runtime-raj: PR created: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/7890 — revert kernel change for region-specific packaging.
acct-manager-zoe: Sent interim update to customer (ticket #AZ-5188). Customer acknowledged and appreciated the rapid response.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation completed, customer impact reduced to minor. Tracking for postmortem.
sre-maya: Final note (15:59 UTC): p99 steady ~1.2s for last 18m, KV hit-rate > 92%. Handoff to SRE day shift complete. Closing thread in 30m if no regressions.
oncall-anna: Thanks all.
